name: Classic Battlegrounds
desc:
👾 Welcome to The Classic Battlegrounds!

🎮 Controls:

    👊 M1 (Mouse Click): Punch (Combo: 4 times)
    🚀 Slam Down: M4 (while in the air)
    🚶‍♂️ Q + W: Dash Punch
    ⬅️➡️ Q + A/D: Side Dash or Ragdoll Cancel
    ⬇️ Q + S: Backward Dash
    🔥 1, 2, 3, 4: Skills
    💥 G: Awaken Mode (Activate when your Awaken Bar is filled)

📈 Game Features:

    Fast-paced combat with unique combos and skills.
    Master dashing with Q + W, Q + A/D, Q + S.
    Awaken Mode: Unlock full potential with G.
